name: InitBufferedStream
evidence: sets mode -1, stores the flags, clears the read, next and count words and rounds the size up to 64 into end, moving start back by the rounding; returns the record (the S137290 record)

name: DestroyBufferedStream
evidence: closes the record with func_001373D0 and, with bit 0 of its flags argument, frees it with func_0018D778

name: OpenBufferedSectorStream
evidence: sets mode 1, stores the start sector at 0x48 and the byte count at 0x10, 0x14 and 0x40, and sets up the 2-or-more chunk ring (counts at 0x4C and 0x58 from the size / 0x100000)

name: OpenBufferedMemoryStream
evidence: sets remaining and the read pointer from its two arguments and mode 2 (read straight from memory)

name: OpenBufferedSectorStreamRange
evidence: passes a KeyId's two words (sector and byte count) to OpenBufferedSectorStream; func_001E4EA8 calls it on the stream it loads from

name: CloseBufferedStream
evidence: by mode closes the file handle (func_001F8C38, mode 0) or finishes the pending sector read (mode 1), then sets mode -1 and zeroes the pointers and counts

name: ReduceBufferedStreamBytesLeft
evidence: subtracts its count from the bytes left of a sector stream at +0x40 (set by OpenBufferedSectorStream) and returns the rest; ReadBufferedBlockHeader calls it

name: RefillBufferedStreamFromSectors
evidence: keeps the ring of chunk buffers filled: completes or restarts the sector reads (func_00140C28 or func_00140CC8 by flags bit 2) and sets rem to at most 0x8000 available bytes

name: RefillBufferedStreamFromFile
evidence: reads min(0x8000, remaining) bytes at the file offset with func_001F8DB8 and stores the result in the pending count

name: RefillBufferedStream
evidence: by mode refills from the file (func_001377C0) or the sector ring (func_00137490), reduces f14 by nextCount (floored at 0) and passes it to func_00193288 when f30 is set

name: UnpackBufferedStream
evidence: decompresses an LZ-style stream (flag bytes, literals, 13-bit back-references of length + 2) into a 0x2000-byte window at 0x70000000, refilling the input with func_00137820, and points cur and remaining at the output

name: ReadBufferedStreamBytes
evidence: copies size bytes to dst (or skips them when dst is 0), refilling through UnpackBufferedStream (flags bit 4) or RefillBufferedStream whenever the current chunk is empty

name: AlignBufferedStreamPosition
evidence: rounds the read pointer at 0x18 up to a multiple of n and takes the skipped bytes off the remaining count at 0x1C; func_001DBA38 calls it with 0x10

name: ReadBufferedU8
evidence: returns the next byte from cur, or reads one through func_00137A60 when remaining is 0

name: ReadBufferedU16
evidence: returns the next little-endian unsigned halfword, via func_00137A60 when fewer than 2 bytes remain

name: ReadBufferedU32
evidence: returns the next little-endian word as unsigned, via func_00137A60 when fewer than 4 bytes remain

name: ReadBufferedS8
evidence: returns the next byte sign-extended, via func_00137A60 when the chunk is empty

name: ReadBufferedS16
evidence: returns the next little-endian halfword sign-extended, via func_00137A60 when fewer than 2 bytes remain

name: ReadBufferedS32
evidence: returns the next little-endian word as signed, via func_00137A60 when fewer than 4 bytes remain

name: ReadBufferedFloat
evidence: assembles the next four bytes into a word and returns it as a float, via func_00137A60 when fewer than 4 remain

name: ReadBufferedVector3
evidence: reads 12 bytes into dst with func_00137A60; func_00192068 and the load slots use it for positions

name: ReadBufferedVector4
evidence: reads 16 bytes into out with func_00137A60

name: ReadBufferedRotation3
evidence: reads three 12-byte rows into buffer, buffer + 0x10 and buffer + 0x20 with func_00137A60

name: ReadBufferedMatrix4
evidence: reads four 12-byte rows into p, p+0x10, p+0x20 and p+0x30 and sets the fourth column to 0, 0, 0, 1.0

name: ReadMeshFromStream
evidence: reads a radius, a vertex count and vertices, then faces, a points array, a words array and an edge list into a mesh record, filling each face's vertex and edge indices from the stream and linking shared edges

name: ReadFaceTree
evidence: reads two counts, allocates 12-byte nodes and fills each with a face address (base + index*32) and back and front links by index (0xFFFF for none) from the buffered stream

name: ReadLinkedItemArray
evidence: reads a count, allocates 32-byte items and fills each from the stream: a vector, a float and two links stored raw when negative or as a pointer into the array otherwise

name: ReadBufferedString
evidence: reads a halfword size, allocates size+1 bytes, reads them from the buffered stream and NUL-terminates

name: SkipBufferedBlock
evidence: reads a halfword count and skips that many bytes of the buffered stream (ReadBufferedStreamBytes with no destination)

name: ReadOptionalBufferedBlock
evidence: reads 0x20 bytes and returns a front-memory copy of them, or 0 when words 1 and 7 of the block are equal
